children: Emkay Global Financial' research report on City Union Bank

City Union Bank (CUBK)’s credit growth continues to accelerate, up ~27% yoy and 7% qoq in 2Q. This, coupled with steady loan yields and stable COF, helped the bank recover margin to 3.88% from 3.78% in 1Q, with PAT at ~Rs4.2bn (27% yoy/~9% qoq) and ROA at ~1.6%. Provisions were slightly higher than expected, as the bank continued building up contingency provisions. Despite an estimated ECL impact of Rs3bn, of which Rs300mn has already been provided for, management expects the remaining Rs2.7bn to be adjusted against capital, with no impact on P&L. With 55% of loans EBLR-linked, management expects NIM to remain at 3.85-3.95% in 3Q-4QFY27, supported by repo rate hike. It remains cautious on sustaining 21–22% deposit growth over the next two years amid competition while targeting credit growth 2–3ppt above industry growth.

We expect the bank to report a strong ROA of ~1.6-1.8% over FY27-29E. This, coupled with a strong capital buffer and improving retail orientation, should help the bank sustain a premium valuation, in our view. We retain BUY and TP of Rs300, valuing the bank at 2.0x Sep-28E ABV.
